events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis and Beady Eye frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Liam's Birthday Vibe
angles.copy: Our Kid turns 54 today! What's your favourite Liam Gallagher moment, from Oasis anthems to his solo swagger?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' released (1971)
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic solo album 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1971, featuring his signature peace anthem.

angles.name: Imagine Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-five years ago, John Lennon gave the world 'Imagine'. A timeless message of peace that still resonates today. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: Apple released the first iPod (2001)
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the original iPod on October 23, 2001, promising '1,000 songs in your pocket', with it becoming available for purchase on November 10, 2001.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? Twenty-five years ago, Apple put '1,000 songs in your pocket' and changed how we listen to music forever. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day celebrates the anniversary of the premiere of the first James Bond film, 'Dr. No', in London on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy Global James Bond Day! From Connery to Craig, who is your definitive 007 and what's your favourite Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder, singer, and songwriter John Lennon was born on this day in 1940 in Liverpool, England.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His music and message continue to inspire generations. Which of his songs means the most to you?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! What's your favourite Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released (1968)
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece. Which track is your unexpected favourite?

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's death (1991)
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury, who died in 1991 at the age of 45 due to AIDS-related pneumonia.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, who left us 35 years ago today. His voice, stage presence, and legacy are truly immortal. What's your favourite Queen song?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released (1965)
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in the UK in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul', an album that pushed boundaries and influenced countless artists. What's your favourite track from this masterpiece?

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death (1980)
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of John Lennon, who was fatally shot in New York City in 1980 at the age of 40.

angles.name: John Lennon Death Anniversary
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, the world lost John Lennon. His legacy of music, peace, and love lives on. What's the John Lennon lyric that stays with you?
